judge.rationale: The candidate only completed the test-writing and spec-updating step of its workflow and never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` or `CHANGELOG.md`. Because `beforeSession` remains outside the `try` block in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, the newly added acceptance test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately when `npm test` runs. While the spec edit in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and the test logic itself are well-constructed, omitting the actual implementation fix and changelog update leaves the core bug unresolved and the test suite broken.
